snippet.title: Kura5: Bonds of the Undying - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
👉https://chickenhat.itch.io/kura5-bonds-of-the-undying

Kura5 is a fangame set within the GBA Boktai universe that uses your local weather data in place of the solar sensor. Utilize the abilities of two characters: Annie the Solar Gunslinger and Emil the Vampire Swordsman, as they are forced into an alliance against a world ending enemy. Play during the daytime and use the Piledriver to "Purify" the remains of an Immortal, or play at night and use the powers of darkness to "Assimilate" your foe. 

Music by LiteralLapin
Bandcamp - https://literallapin.bandcamp.com
Soundcloud - https://soundcloud.com/literallapin
